applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic, ongoing 25% tuition reduction rather than a competitive scholarship you apply for - QUT reads your course application and issues the offer alongside your admissions offer letter, so there is no separate form and no separate deadline to miss. It runs every semester for as long as you keep meeting your course's academic requirements, which makes it one of the more durable discounts in QUT's international range, but it is not a full scholarship: 75% of tuition plus everything else is still on you. Eligibility is purely academic - QUT explicitly says educational disruption, medical circumstances and financial need will not be considered - and the postgraduate bar is concrete: GPA 5.00 on a 7-point scale for an Australian bachelor degree or higher, or GPA 5.50 or equivalent for other recognised bachelor degrees. If you apply and don't receive it and haven't started yet, you can request a review through your agent or by replying to your offer email, but you must include a statement of why you believe you qualified plus supporting documentation.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Future international undergraduate and postgraduate coursework applicants with strong, clean academic records in eligible courses who want an automatic, renewable 25% tuition reduction.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your intended course is on the eligible courses list (all five faculties are included, plus double degrees, vertical double degrees and international transfer programs)
Check the postgraduate standard against your result: GPA 5.00 on a 7-point scale for an Australian bachelor or higher, or GPA 5.50 or equivalent for another recognised bachelor or higher
Use QUT's published conversion table if your scale is not a 7-point one - for example a 4-point scale where 2 is a pass converts to 3.00, and a percentage where 60% is a pass converts to 80%
Make sure you are commencing the course for the first time; returning to a prior QUT course of study rules you out
Check you are not holding another QUT academic scholarship, which makes you ineligible for this one
If you are using a QUT pathway program to meet English requirements, note you become eligible only once you start the degree program
If no offer arrives and you have not commenced, request a review with a written justification and supporting documents
common_rejection_risks: Holding another QUT academic scholarship, which makes you ineligible for this one
Returning to a prior course of study at QUT, since QUT will not reconsider you
Falling below the GPA 5.00 / 5.50 standards for your study level, which means no offer with your admissions letter
Relying on hardship, medical or educational-disruption grounds, which QUT states are not considered at all
Assuming the per-country high school minimum is a single global mark when it varies by country and qualification
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 75% of tuition fees each semester, plus living costs, accommodation, Overseas Student Health Cover, flights and visa costs. QUT's hub also points applicants to its own fees and financial-aid pages for these.
document_audit: There is no scholarship document set - everything is judged off your course application, so your transcripts are the whole evidence base
Your 'best result' across all accepted qualifications is used, so submit the strongest complete academic history rather than a single selected transcript
The postgraduate GPA conversions are published as a table of alternative scales - check which row your grading system falls into before assuming you miss out
A review request after a non-award must include both a statement of why you believe you qualified and supporting documentation, or it will not be considered
alerts: Eligibility is solely academic; QUT explicitly rules out educational disruption, medical circumstances and financial need
The reduction is ongoing but conditional - keep meeting your course's ongoing academic requirements to retain it each semester
Holding another QUT academic scholarship disqualifies you from this one
Review requests are only open if you have not yet commenced study as per your offer letter, so act before orientation

QUT's wider international range also includes the International Talent Scholarship (20% per semester, selected faculties and countries) and the QUT College Merit Scholarship (25% of the first semester of a foundation or diploma) - different rules, so check you are reading the right page
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to study an eligible course at QUT, let QUT assess your qualifications automatically, and receive the scholarship offer together with your admissions offer letter.
